prompt:
Create ONE polished enemy selection concept sheet for a first-person music-fantasy survival roguelite. Match the attached reference sheet's exact visual language and presentation: landscape 16:9, a clean FOUR COLUMNS by TWO ROWS grid, pale warm ivory background, thin warm gold grid dividers, eight complete full-body character concepts, generous separation, soft grounding shadows. This is a NEW roster: DO NOT copy characters or old numbers from reference. Each cell contains exactly ONE distinct character and a large dark burgundy two-digit number beneath it. No other text. Equal visual importance, no overlapping bodies, no cropped feet, props or head ornaments. Characters may be scaled within their cells for readability, not a physical scale chart.
STYLE: retro hand-painted Japanese animation translated to refined 3D cel-shaded game concept art, crisp ink contours, expressive silhouettes, decisive two/three-tone hard shadows, matte painted wood and cloth, antique brass, ivory, burgundy, midnight indigo, restrained muted teal. Charming but clearly hostile music-fantasy creatures. Not photorealistic, not chibi, not generic steampunk robots. Music theme beyond theater: enchanted acoustic instruments, rhythm beasts, resonance spirits, musical symbols. Keep anatomy buildable, detailed enough to model but not noisy. No guns, sci-fi equipment, neon equalizers, gore, stage scenery, HUD, ability labels, attacks or effects covering character anatomy. Do not give every character the same porcelain face mask; use species-specific faces and expressions.
EXACT NUMBER LAYOUT: top row 17, 18, 19, 20; bottom row 21, 22, 23, 24. Only these eight number labels.
17 GRAMOPHONE SNAIL: low crawling indigo velvet snail carrying an antique gramophone cabinet shell, huge petal-like brass sound horn growing upward, small black record on shell top, two expressive eye stalks. Wide spiraling silhouette.
18 PANPIPE HEDGEHOG: round squat hedgehog whose quills are graduated wooden panpipes rising in a fan, small pointed snout, cream face, dark paws, burgundy binding around the pipes. Distinct spiny mound silhouette.
19 CASTANET FLYING FISH: floating predatory fish made from two polished chestnut castanet shells opening like jaws, ivory teeth-like rim accents, thin burgundy silk fin webs and a split tail, expressive narrow eyes. Sleek compact nonhumanoid.
20 GONG TORTOISE: heavy low giant tortoise with an upright circular suspended bronze gong nested into its arched shell frame, central raised gong boss, sturdy ivory carved feet, deep indigo leathery neck. Wide defensive silhouette, gong is very recognizable.
21 BAGPIPE BOAR: charging stocky boar with burgundy plaid bagpipe hide, three wooden drone pipes growing from shoulders, curved ivory tusks and a short chanter snout, charcoal hooves. Textile body visibly puffed but clear boar anatomy.
22 MARACA CACTUS: upright desert plant creature, two asymmetric long arm branches ending in painted wooden maracas, ribbed muted teal trunk, small triangular eyes, short root feet and small red flower crest. Maracas patterned ivory and burgundy, no face mask.
23 LUTE BLOSSOM: ambulatory flower creature with pear-shaped lute soundboard as its torso, delicate carved rosette soundhole, neck growing into a bud crown, large burgundy petal collar, leaf arms and curling root legs. Elegant botanical asymmetry.
24 DOUBLE-BASS BEAR: massive broad-shouldered bear with carved dark wood double-bass torso, four heavy paws, ivory muzzle, thick stretched strings across belly, long scroll curving above shoulder, burgundy fur around neck. Stooped quadrupedal power, not a violin puppet.
Match reference palette and rendering closely, while all eight silhouettes must be distinct and new.
